action_summary: The merged instant-learning audit named the open lever: connect settlement_v1 question selection to rule admission. The taught-edit path banked a rule from one demonstration and applied it to any same-shaped target with no oracle consulted -- measured defect 6: the demo a<=hi -> a<hi taught on `inside` silently makes `is_last_index` wrong at the boundary. This round ships the missing edge as canonical/swe_kernel/taught_actions/settled_admission_v1.py: two hypotheses about the target's correct form (apply_teach / keep_target) are loaded as runnable code, probed on the grid where they can disagree, and settled by chosen questions. The FIRST protocol -- one question, posterior settles -- was FALSIFIED by its own confirmatory run: at (-1,-1) the oracle legitimately answers False, apply_teach agrees, and the ruler declared the WRONG rule settled -- the audit's 0/200 one-success result reproduced in miniature. The shipped protocol is asymmetric: REFUSE at the first oracle contradiction; ADMIT only when every disagreement point has been asked and agreed; fail closed with no oracle, an unprobeable target, or partial coverage. MEASURED on the merged tree (a5e0a347dd, #6699's modified edit_by_example included): P1 defect reproduces (is_last_index(3,3) -> False, intended True); refusal costs exactly 2 questions (comparison family) and 1 question (binop family); admission costs 5 (full coverage); budget-0 and partial-coverage refuse with PARTIAL_COVERAGE; rename-mismatched and already-edited targets stay REFUSED_SHAPE. Audit receipts re-run on this tree: one demo held-out accuracy 0.10 vs one demo + chosen questions 1.00 (10/10 settled, mean 2.0 queries); one success 0/200 identified vs chosen failures 25/25 at mean 2.76. 165 pre-existing taught-edit tests pass; edit_by_example_v1.py is not modified by this round. The oracle is the minimum question interface: #6699's mutation-scored project check can be this gate's oracle, and the gate's disagreement points tell any check exactly where to look.

routes_ranked: 1. Generalise the lifter to constant collections + discriminating-grid gates -- chosen: one rule, all machinery already measured, both families served

obs_solution.losing_routes_reason: Special-casing duplicates what the general rule does; emission changes the execution contract of every downstream organ consumer for a win the replay path already delivers at the system level; a donor violates the ownership law.
